QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.j.literal: def jetPolynomial (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ[X] := taylor (-a) (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), monomial j (v j / (j.factorial : ℝ)))
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.j.normalized: jetPolynomial a k v = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), Polynomial.C (v j / (j.factorial : ℝ)) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)^j
